items.q: This was an old-time trumpet player. He was fat. He would look like Freddie Keppard. Big, fat guy.

ctx.x: A cat who looked like Freddie Keppard in Chicago, who was such a terrific trumpet player. Great, big fat guy. They called him Fatso...
Mmm-hmm, that was Reuben Reeves. Which of course, everybody knows about him.
This was an old-time trumpet player. He was fat. He would look like Freddie Keppard. Big, fat guy.
